ideas.pitch: A Python-based algorithmic trading strategy that parses real-time financial news headlines and regulatory filings using lightweight NLP, feeding polarity and entity sentiment scores directly into a dynamic mean-reversion trading model.
ideas.title: Sentiment-Driven Mean Reversion Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines financial intuition with natural language processing, similar to winning data science solutions, scoring high on algorithmic performance metrics.

ideas.pitch: An automated algorithmic engine that ingests external whale wallet positioning and perp market order-flow data in Python, executing conditional hedging and trend-following orders in the isolated simulation environment.
ideas.title: Crypto Perp Copy-Trading Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages execution speed and strategic positioning insights similar to grand prize-winning perpetual trading bots.

ideas.pitch: A high-frequency quantitative strategy built in Python that analyzes Level 2 market order book depth and bid-ask volume imbalances to predict short-term price direction and execute rapid micro-trades within the simulation.
ideas.title: Order Book Imbalance Momentum Scalper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core thesis of the hackathon—that speed is an edge and strategy is everything—maximizing returns through microstructure analysis.

ideas.pitch: A quantitative asset allocation algorithm that detects market regime shifts (volatility breakouts vs. ranging markets) using statistical hidden Markov models in Python, automatically rebalancing weights across simulated assets.
ideas.title: Regime-Switching Portfolio Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates rigorous statistical thinking and quantitative depth, impressing judges looking for robust mathematical risk management.

ideas.pitch: A systematic Python trading strategy that ingests historical macroeconomic data series, computes surprise indices against consensus forecasts, and executes automated multi-asset trades upon data release timestamps.
ideas.title: Macroeconomic Indicator Momentum Trader
ideas.why_it_could_win: Exploits data science techniques on structured economic datasets to generate alpha during volatile market events.
